description: This file defines a Flutter widget named SettingsScreen, which displays user information and provides a logout option. It retrieves user data from an AuthProvider using Provider's context.watch and performs navigation via a custom AppRouter.

classes.name: SettingsScreen
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that displays user settings and allows logout.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the settings screen UI, showing user info and a logout button.
